provider: NAKALA (IR* Huma-Num, CNRS / French national HSS data repository)

free_tier.stated: Public deposits are explicitly uncapped: 'Il n'existe aucune limite pour les dépôts publics' (there is no limit for public deposits), and 'Un accès à vos données sans limite de volumétrie, ni de temps' (access to your data with no volume or time limit). The only quota is on PRIVATE staging: 10,000 private deposits or 100 GB equivalent.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: Publication mints a DOI via DataCite and is irreversible. Deletion requires a request to Huma-Num, so this is a permanent archive, not scratch space.

egress.terms: Free. Files are served from Huma-Num/IN2P3-hosted infrastructure in France with no metering and no egress charge; public deposits are downloadable by any visitor and IIIF image endpoints are exposed for tif/tiff/jpg/jpeg/jp2.

tooling: Documented REST API split into search / datas / collections / groups / users / vocabularies, with a per-account API key ('Certaines opérations nécessitent ... sa clé d'API disponible dans son compte personnel'); swagger at api.nakala.fr/doc, separate test instance apitest.nakala.fr. Also OAI-PMH (api.nakala.fr/oai2?verb=Identify), a SPARQL triplestore, IIIF Image API, and a published notebook at gitlab.huma-num.fr/huma-num-public/notebook-api-nakala. No rclone backend.
chaining: Unlimited public deposits per account, no volume cap per deposit. So the account is the only unit and it does not need multiplying for 500 GB. Groups feature shares deposit rights across a project team, so a lab can pour many researchers' output into one quota-free surface.
limits_note: Private staging capped at 10,000 deposits / 100 GB; public deposits uncapped. Publication mints a DOI via DataCite and is irreversible. Deletion requires a request to Huma-Num, so this is a permanent archive, not scratch space. Eligibility is the real limit: the depositor must belong to the French academic world, or be part of a project whose lead team is French-academic.
reliability_note: CRITICAL liveness flag: nakala.fr and api.nakala.fr both returned HTTP 503 on 6 consecutive probes across ~25 minutes (site and API, direct and through the proxy), so the quota is docs-verified but the service was NOT live at probe time. Budget-stable (CNRS-funded national infrastructure) but treat availability as unconfirmed.
confidence_note: Unverified: carried from historical research records without live verification. A first-party page read confirms documentation.

extras.agent_focus: Exotic and institutional surfaces: national libraries/archives, museum and heritage platforms, genomics/biobank consortia, audiovisual archives, government open-data portals, institutional repositories (DSpace/EPrints/Dataverse/Invenio) that accept EXTERNAL depositors, publishing platforms, religious/cultural bulk corpora. Priority seam: a university or national repository whose deposit door is open to anyone and whose write path is an API.
